system.unidentifiedDesc: An odd ring that seems to fit any finger perfectly.
system.description: When found, this ring has [[/r 1d6 #Spells stored]] spells stored within it. Those exact spells are the limit of the ring's powers and they cannot be changed. When the ring is put on, the wearer magically knows what spells are stored and how to use them. After a spell is used, it may be replaced by a spellcaster who must cast the replacement spell directly at the ring. The ring will not absorb spells thrown at the wearer. The spells in the ring have the duration, range, and effect equal to the lowest level needed to cast them. The DM should select the type of spells in the ring; about [[/r 1d100 #1-20=Cleric spells, 21-00=Magic-User spells]] 20% of these rings typically contain clerical spells.
